text.p: Dentsply International Inc chief executive John Miles said the dental supply company's earnings per share could grow 15 percent in 1997, to a range of $2.85 to $2.90, according to financial weekly Barron's.

Miles told Barron's he expects internal growth of seven to eight percent a year. For 1996, he said Dentsply should match analysts estimates' of $2.50 a share by maintaining its 25 percent growth pace set in the first half of the year.
In 1995, the company earned $2.00 a share after a charge of $0.07 seven cents to close an Illinois office.
"I'll be disappointed if we don't make any acquisitions this year," Miles added. He was named president and chief executive in December 1994.
Shares of Dentsply closed on Friday off 1/4 to 40-3/4 on the Nasdaq.
